title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to check whether the current page/report is standard or customized
summary: This post explains how to determine whether a Business Central page or report is standard or customized using object ID ranges, page inspection, and performance profiler tools. It helps developers and partners quickly identify whether functionality has been extended or modified.
key_points: Object ID ranges show origin: 0-49,999 is base app, 50,000-99,999 is per-tenant customization, 100,000-999,999 is Microsoft localization, 1,000,000-69,999,999 is RSP and 70,000,000-74,999,999 is AppSource apps
Page Inspection (Ctrl+Alt+F1) shows page and report IDs, and its Extensions tab lists extensions that add or extend the page or its source table; it does not show extensions for reports
The AL profiler (VS Code since BC19, in-client since BC20) lists active apps and the call tree, but only detects custom code that actually runs during the recording
Error details and the AL call stack, also available through View the last known error, show which extension objects were involved

quotes.text: The extension model is object-based; you create new objects, and extend existing objects depending on what you want your extension to do.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the fundamental architecture behind identifying whether pages are standard or customized
